title: 从自由能视角区分后训练中的能力激发与能力创造
summary: 本文提出后训练应区分能力激发（在模型已有行为空间内重新加权）与能力创造（改变可达行为空间）。通过自由能视角，将SFT和RL视为对预训练参考分布的不同重加权，核心问题不再是SFT vs RL，而是是否扩展了模型的可达行为空间。
summary_en: This paper argues that post-training should distinguish between capability elicitation (reweighting within existing behavioral space) and capability creation (expanding reachable behaviors). Using a free-energy perspective, SFT and RL are both reweighting of the pretrained distribution; the key question is whether the model's reachable behavioral space is expanded.
